description: A lead is created from one of five channels with its source touch recorded.
Channel-specific required fields and formats are checked.
Tiered duplicate rules compare the lead with open and recent leads and prospects.
Employee band 1-499, operating in Canada, not an existing relationship, not public administration.
Synthetic FSA resolves to an SGC 2021 CMA or provincial remainder, then to a territory.
Employee band maps to a segment; NAICS 2022 sector resolves specialist need.
Lead, market-context and operational inputs are assembled (no score in this design).
Only valid, unique, eligible leads in READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT enter routing.
Candidate RMs are filtered by availability and hard capacity, then balanced by workload.
One active primary assignment (or an approved queue) is created with rule version and reason.
The RM acknowledges ownership within the acknowledgement SLA.
Contact attempts and the first two-way contact are recorded as activities.
Follow-up activities, nurturing tasks and outcomes are recorded.
Every SLA clock is started, warned, breached or met and recorded as an SLA event.
Missed acknowledgement, inactivity, unavailability or manager decision ends the assignment and creates a new one.
Breaches and queue ageing escalate to the Regional Sales Manager, then to the Director.
The RM confirms need, fit and intent; qualification opens an opportunity.
An opportunity record tracks the qualified pursuit separately from the lead.
The opportunity is won (lead converted) or the lead closes with a disposition.
Terminal leads carry a valid disposition; KPIs are reported by channel, market, segment and RM.
